raw_response:
This is my only piece of land, just 0.21 hectares, so I must do everything I can to get a good harvest from it. I will use the improved maize seed from the FISP program because it gives better yields than the local seed we used to plant. I will also apply chemical fertilizer — maybe one bag of NPK and some urea that I can get through the subsidy — because without fertilizer the soil here is too tired to produce much. The rest of the work we will do ourselves as a family; the plot is small enough that we do not need to hire anyone, and we have no money for that anyway. We depend on the rains, so we cannot irrigate, and we never spray chemicals on food crops.
